notes.title: 3.30 Update (v.1.4)
notes.content:
v1.4更新说明：

The English version of this game is released, but it isn't complete, only contains half of the content.
I put the English Demo in the same folder as the Chinese version. You still need to buy the game before you play the Demo of English, but I will finish it as soon as possible.

The best way to start the Demo game is to open an executable called "MagicCat (E)" in the folder in the game directory.

My English isn't very good, there must be some grammatical mistakes, thank you for your understand.
